vibe_rationale: Community-driven sauna culture with curated saunas, aufguss and brands woven in as experiences, but a single scene and a young event, so narrower than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: A direct wellness fit: a recovery-minded crowd with health partners already in (Otsuka Pharmaceutical, Sansho Pharmaceutical). The organiser sells 'the experience becomes the ad' packages, and cold plunge and hydration sampling are natural. Small and low cost, but Japan-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
